All — quick legal read and recommended path. I compared Acme's redline (attached) to our standard customer-visibility MOU. Key points:

- Telemetry/data sharing: their redline tries to require access to anonymized usage metrics and a quarterly sync. We should not commit to ongoing telemetry access in the MOU. If Acme wants a regular business review call, that's fine but keep data-sharing language limited to aggregated, non-identifiable metrics we already publish.
- Indemnity / IP: they attempted to insert a broader license back to Acme. Reject — we grant limited, revocable usage rights for quote + logo only.
- Approval window: 48 hours is fine.

Recommendation: Accept the marketing flow (10% base + conditional 2% make-good for accepting our MOU edits). Require removal of the telemetry clause and addition of a 90-day termination right for the publicity asset. If Vivek approves the additional 2% as a one-time retention credit, legal will produce a short MOU and I can send it to Acme to sign.

If we want to escalate: Vivek, the ask is effectively a 12% credit on renewal (~$50k). Standard comp for deals of this size may exceed our delegated discount authority. If you approve, I'll prepare the MOU for signature.

Thanks,
